# Default rules for all bots
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /calculator/
Allow: /about
Allow: /calculators
Allow: /contact
Allow: /faq
Allow: /privacy
Allow: /terms

# Disallow private/error pages
Disallow: /404
Disallow: /500
Disallow: /error
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /history
Disallow: /*.json$
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api

# Disallow query parameters that don't add value
Disallow: /*?*utm_
Disallow: /*?*fbclid=
Disallow: /*?*gclid=

# Crawl-delay and request-rate (1 request per second)
Crawl-delay: 1
Request-rate: 1/1s

# Specific rules for aggressive bots
User-agent: AhrefsBot
User-agent: SemrushBot
User-agent: DotBot
Crawl-delay: 10

# Allow Google and Bing to crawl everything
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# Sitemaps
Sitemap: https://calaifitness.com/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://calaifitness.com/sitemap-index.xml
